leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a class component with TypeScript to serve as an Error Boundary.
Implement the getDerivedStateFromError lifecycle method to update state when an error occurs.
Apply the componentDidCatch lifecycle method to log error information for debugging.
Construct a conditional render to display fallback UI when an error state is active.
Utilize the Error Boundary component to wrap child components and catch errors.
Control error propagation by placing Error Boundaries at strategic points in the component tree.
Invoke the Error Boundary component in JSX with proper TypeScript syntax.
Access error and errorInfo parameters within lifecycle methods to handle error details.
Return appropriate JSX from the Error Boundary for both normal and error states.
Modify existing component structures to integrate Error Boundary protection.
